text: 科创50冲高回落涨超2%，光伏板块集体爆发。 恒指半日涨3.1%，恒生科技指数涨4.8%，美团、阿里巴巴、腾讯等集体大涨。 韩国股市盘中一度跌超5%，高盛称美国的“蓝色海啸”将对AI监管产生重大影响。 《国务院关于金融工作情况的报告》全文发布：支持中央汇金公司发挥类平准基金作用，巩固完善资本市场稳市机制。 第九届进博会开幕式举行。 珠海拟1.81亿元收储华发旗下闲置土地。
text_en: STAR 50 surged then pulled back, closing up more than 2%, with the photovoltaic sector rallying across the board. The Hang Seng Index rose 3.1% at midday, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 4.8%, with Meituan, Alibaba, Tencent and others surging collectively. South Korea's stock market fell more than 5% intraday, with Goldman Sachs saying the US "blue wave" will have a major impact on AI regulation. The full text of the "State Council Report on Financial Work" was released: support Central Huijin Company in playing a quasi-stabilization fund role, and consolidate and improve the capital market stabilization mechanism. The opening ceremony of the 9th China International Import Expo was held. Zhuhai plans to spend RMB 181 million to take over idle land under Huafa.
